label: PF Backlog 285
title: Result Aggregator: combine multi-agent/multi-model outputs + conflict resolution + evidence merger + provenance
body: Doc1 s8-10 / audit PF-152. No general result aggregator exists (multi_model_review is majority-vote only and has a quorum bug: a single pass can pass the review). Need: combine outputs from multiple agents/models/tools preserving source model/agent, timestamp, evidence, confidence, conflicts, validation status, test evidence, unresolved issues; conflict_resolver; evidence_merger; feed close_loop/pr_gate. Owns core/result_aggregator.py.
